reasons.problem: Five years of experience is described only as duties, with no outcome anywhere. 'Improved performance' gives no metric, no method and no sense of scale. 'Responsible for the frontend of several client projects' gives no number of projects, team size or stack. I can't tell whether this person owned the work or just contributed to it, and in a pile of 120 the candidates with measured results get the interviews.
reasons.fix: Rewrite each bullet as action, method and result, for example 'Cut Largest Contentful Paint on the main web app from 4.1s to 2.2s by code-splitting and image optimisation'. State the number of client projects, the team size and the stack for each. Drop 'Helped the juniors' or give it numbers (how many juniors, what changed).
reasons.quote: Improved the performance of the main web app

reasons.problem: This is the strongest line on the CV. A shared React design system is the kind of ownership-level frontend work I want at 4+ years, and it matches the React, TypeScript and CSS/Sass skills listed. It is undermined by 'Worked on', which doesn't show what the candidate actually did, and by having no adoption or impact figures.
reasons.fix: State the candidate's role and results: 'Built X components in React and TypeScript with Storybook, adopted by N projects, cutting UI build time by Y%'. Add accessibility or testing practices if they apply. Move this bullet to the top of the current role.
reasons.quote: Worked on a React design system used by the whole team

reasons.problem: A date of birth on a Belgian CV breaks the local convention and signals the candidate doesn't know it. The same goes for language levels given as 'native · very good · basic' instead of CEFR (A1-C2), and for the emoji in the 'About me' heading. Each is small, but together they make the CV look careless in a pile where most applicants get these details right.
reasons.fix: Delete the date of birth. Give languages as 'Dutch: C2 · English: C1 · French: A2'. Remove the emoji and replace the generic 'Hardworking and passionate' summary with one line stating years of experience, stack and strongest result.
